estimate.explanation: Dockerfile has 70 lines with 13 layer-creating instructions (RUN/COPY/ADD). Each layer adds build-time memory overhead. Estimated runtime memory: 416 MB, CPU: 520m.

warnings.message: Pin versions in apt get install. Instead of `apt-get install <package>` use `apt-get install <package>=<version>`

securityIssues.message: Container runs as root: no USER instruction in final stage
securityIssues.suggestion: Create a non-privileged user and switch to it with USER before the entrypoint.
